input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include api error details, authenticated user details, authentication. Core business data revolves around Authority, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage api error details operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage authenticated user details operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
